visualReview.notes: Inspected the main preview, all four rotations and five architectural detail views. The main gate has a through-passage, the courtyard has a paved center approach and rows of stone steles, and the bell and drum towers have different lower structures and colors. Stepped front approaches, the green roof silhouette and the distinct detached seven-roof gate read at the intended scales.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all ten dated shared-material views and the placement view. Glazed ceramic, timber, plaster and masonry resolve in the bounded viewer placement. The placement unload check passed. The world placement fixture uses flat terrain and the original source field was inspected separately.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 26 current context, close and detail-level comparison views. All four levels preserve the central and outer ranges, their open courtyards, adjacent towers and the detached gate. At closer levels the door lattice, bracket bands, distinct tower podiums, steps and stele approaches are visible.

geographicReview.notes: The original 320 m Terrarium field, sixteen native outlines and signed site orientation determine the physical placement. Inspected the ground around the axial gate, main court and lower south approach. The paifang center is estimated at the north end of Shenlu Street from official written sources and native local road/plaza geometry. The estimate is retained in archway-controls.json.

fidelityReview.scope: The preserved Dongyue Temple compound in its 2023 appearance, with connecting halls, Daizong Hall’s glazed roofs and red walls, the gate, bell and drum towers and the flanking courtyard galleries.
fidelityReview.notes: The six cleared Qualla originals inform vermilion frames, painted bracket bands, roof shapes, the warm bell tower profile and the green-roofed drum tower on the arched gray masonry base. Native map features establish the courtyard arrangement. Beijing municipal records describe the hall sequence and the Ming archway; inscriptions and finer decorative details are simplified.

imageryReview.notes: Inspected six exact published Qualla originals. Their hashes match Commons own-work uploads by EditQ, whose current account is 호고호. All six are CC0. Used municipal descriptions as text for the axial arrangement and the exterior arch dimensions.

validation.sharedCaptureScope: The September 2023 Beijing Dongyue Temple compound, including all sixteen mapped buildings and a separate Ming paifang across Chaoyangmenwai Avenue.

limitations: Native OpenStreetMap controls establish sixteen compound building envelopes. Main roof breaks, axial openings, woodwork, minor roof finishes, steps and floor and ridge elevations are inferred from the cleared photographs and written descriptions.

The seven-roof Ming paifang is placed approximately at the mouth of Shenlu Street, across Chaoyangmenwai Avenue. Authorities give its overall width and approximate height. Its depth and small moulding profiles are estimated.
Representative stele positions and exterior paving are simplified. Interior exhibits, carved inscriptions, statues, foliage and minor fixtures are outside the modeled scope.
Foundations follow the frozen original source field with local averaging per building. Terrain samples do not resolve individual courtyard steps or foundation heights.
